clue.text: Condemn unheard before an arbitrator

parts.note: pre- is the Latin-derived prefix meaning before
an arbitrator is a judge who settles a dispute

explanation.surface: Someone is condemned without a hearing before an arbitrator.
explanation.definitionFit: To condemn without hearing the case is to decide its outcome in advance.

clue.text: Watch the firearm

definitions.meaning: a pocket watch that chimes the hours when a button is pressed
a gun that fires several shots without reloading

explanation.definitionFit: A chiming pocket watch and a multi-shot rifle both take this name because each repeats its action.

clue.text: John Clerk's a pompous public official

parts.note: Jack is a familiar form of the name John
a clerk is, that is, someone at work in an office

explanation.surface: A man called John, a clerk, is described as a self-important bureaucrat.
explanation.walkthrough: Clerk's is read as 'clerk is', and a clerk is someone in office.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase is an old idiom for a petty bureaucrat who is puffed up by a little authority.

clue.text: Remove despite having been allowed into river

indicators.note: into tells us one word is placed inside the river's name

parts.note: the Dee is a river in Wales, England and Scotland
to let is to allow

explanation.surface: Someone is taken away even though they were permitted to enter a river.
explanation.definitionFit: To remove words or data is to strike them out or erase them.

clue.text: Waterway in the Broads? Yes and no

indicators.note: in shows the waterway sits inside the words the Broads

explanation.surface: Asking whether a certain river is in the Norfolk Broads, the answer is both yes and no.
explanation.walkthrough: Yes and no: the river is not in the Norfolk Broads (a region of waterways in eastern England), but it is in the words 'the Broads'.
explanation.definitionFit: The Ebro is a major river of north-east Spain, a natural waterway.

clue.text: Cold hanging about at Christmas time

definitions.text: Cold hanging about at Christmas time

parts.words: Cold hanging about at Christmas time
parts.note: seems to describe a lingering winter chill, but means a festive paper decoration hung up at Christmas; a cold that streams also suggests the word

explanation.definitionFit: A long coloured paper ribbon hung as a decoration at Christmas parties.

clue.text: Look beyond the river during the game

indicators.note: beyond puts the word for look after the river in the answer

parts.note: the Po is the great river of northern Italy
lo is an old word for look or behold

explanation.surface: Someone is told to gaze past the river while a match is on.
explanation.definitionFit: Polo is a team sport played on horseback with mallets.

clue.text: Mobs fellow cattle breeder

parts.note: mobs are crowds, or herds
a fellow is a man

explanation.surface: A farmer who breeds cattle is described as a man of crowds.
explanation.definitionFit: A herdsman owns or tends a herd of livestock.

clue.text: Both bare parts disguised in towelling

indicators.note: the parts of the two words are disguised, so their letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Two naked parts of the body are hidden in a towel.
explanation.definitionFit: A loose gown often made of absorbent terry cloth, worn after bathing.

clue.text: Poem is among those picked out

annotationWithheld.why: Poem is among those picked out (EPIC): no parse found; 'is' or 'those picked out' does not yield E,P,C around I, and searches give no text for this clue
annotationWithheld.clue: Poem is among those picked out

clue.text: Promise to retain a single weapon

parts.note: to keep is to retain
one is single
a sword is a weapon

explanation.surface: Someone vows to hold on to just one blade.
explanation.definitionFit: To honour a pledge is to do what you said you would.

clue.text: Streets with average amounts of resources

parts.note: ways are streets or roads
and means together with
means are averages in arithmetic

explanation.surface: Roads with typical quantities of supplies are listed.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom names the methods and funds available for getting something done.

clue.text: Rockiest but not likely to topple over!

definitions.text: Rockiest but not likely to topple over!

parts.words: Rockiest but not likely to topple over!
parts.note: rocky can mean wobbly, but here it means full of rocks, so the most rocky ground is anything but unsteady

explanation.definitionFit: Most full of stones, the superlative of a word meaning covered with rocks.

clue.text: Notice when the tenants have gone

definitions.text: Notice when the tenants have gone

parts.words: Notice when the tenants have gone
parts.note: a notice put up on a building once the occupants leave, offering it for rent

explanation.definitionFit: A sign advertising that a property is available for rent.

clue.text: Might on the border produce malicious damage

parts.note: may is a verb like might
a hem is the border of a garment

explanation.surface: Power at a frontier leads to wanton destruction.
explanation.definitionFit: Legally the term once meant violent maiming; now it is general chaos and destruction.

clue.text: Count in German

parts.note: seems to ask for German numbers, but means the German noble title equal to an earl

explanation.definitionFit: Graf is the German title for a nobleman of the rank of count.

clue.text: Designed to attract attention of US soldier, Frenchman and Michael, say

parts.note: GI is an American soldier
M is the abbreviation of Monsieur, a French man
Micky is a pet form of Michael

explanation.surface: An American soldier, a Frenchman and a man named Michael are all said to be showy.
explanation.definitionFit: Something with a gimmick relies on a trick or novelty to catch the eye.

clue.text: Discordant blare from farm machine

indicators.note: discordant suggests jumbled sound, so the letters are shuffled

explanation.surface: A tractor attachment gives out a harsh blast of noise.
explanation.definitionFit: A baler compresses hay or straw into bales.

clue.text: Be firing at random whilst issuing instructions

indicators.note: at random says the letters are mixed up in no set order

explanation.surface: A commander tells troops to shoot indiscriminately while giving orders.
explanation.definitionFit: A briefing is a meeting at which orders or information are given.

clue.text: Taking part of a similar nature

indicators.note: part says the answer is only a section of the word Taking

explanation.surface: Participating in something comparable.
explanation.definitionFit: Two things related or alike in character are described as kindred.

clue.text: Bright spark starts car

parts.note: a bright spark sounds like a clever person, but is the literal spark in the system that fires the engine

explanation.definitionFit: The ignition system sparks the fuel to start a car's engine.

clue.text: Physician, one from an Italian family

parts.note: a medic is a doctor
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A doctor is one member of a famous Italian house.
explanation.definitionFit: The Medici were the rich banking dynasty that ruled Renaissance Florence.

clue.text: Stepping on tricky gradient

indicators.note: tricky suggests something twisted, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Walking on a difficult slope.
explanation.definitionFit: Treading is walking or putting your feet down on something.

clue.text: Identical notes about topless tunic for a girl

indicators.note: about means the two notes sit around the rest

parts.note: two matching notes, each E from the musical scale

indicators.note: topless says the first letter of tunic is taken off

explanation.surface: Matching musical notes surround a young woman's tunic missing its top.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Identical notes' is two of the same musical note, E and E; a tunic without its top loses its first letter before going inside them.
explanation.definitionFit: Eunice is a female first name.

clue.text: Meddling with the signals

definitions.meaning: meddling is poking into other people's affairs
the disturbance that spoils radio or television reception

explanation.definitionFit: The word covers both unwelcome intrusion in affairs and disruption of a broadcast signal.

clue.text: It was repeatedly taken up to the monkey

indicators.note: taken up in a down clue means the letters are read from bottom to top
repeatedly means the word is written out twice

explanation.surface: Something was carried up again and again to an ape.
explanation.definitionFit: The titi is a small South American monkey.

clue.text: Profligate has nothing to be sorry about

indicators.note: about means the word for regret goes round the zero

parts.note: to rue is to be sorry
O looks like zero, nothing

explanation.surface: A spendthrift feels no regret about anything.
explanation.definitionFit: A rake or debauched man given to dissipation.

clue.text: One with six old pence was very keen

parts.note: a means one
VI is the Roman numeral for six
d was the symbol for a penny in British pre-decimal money

explanation.surface: Someone who had a few old pennies was eager.
explanation.definitionFit: Avid means eager or enthusiastic.

clue.text: Mud a tank removed from the capital

indicators.note: removed suggests things shifted away, so these letters are relocated into a new order

explanation.surface: Dirt and an army tank are cleared out of a city.
explanation.definitionFit: Kathmandu, also spelt this way, is the capital city of Nepal.

clue.text: Plainchant during the service?

parts.note: split as plain and chant, it gives level plus song; also a sung evening service in the Anglican church

explanation.definitionFit: The Anglican evening service of prayers and canticles.
